source_value.trigger: Nothing the viewer does: a 90.12s screen recording of the Xero web app that plays itself. Inside it the pointer moves on its own — it climbs to the Purchases nav item by ~13.5s and the menu opens at 14.0s, it hovers "Expenses" by 15.5s, and it reaches the claim row's overflow control at 72.0s.
source_value.start_state: Grey "Xero Expenses" title card carrying the bullet "Capture costs as they happen" alone at 0s, with a second bullet "Keep track of your spending" present by 6s (media/motion.mp4 0-9.5s).
source_value.end_state: Expenses > To pay list reading "To pay 267.02" with a blue "Pay all · 267.02" button and the two claim rows, held to the last sampled frame at 89.5s.
source_value.continuity: One 90.12s recording at 25 fps (2251 frames). The title card cross-dissolves into the Foxglove Studios business overview between 10.0s and 11.0s — at 10.5s both images are visible in the same frame — and from 11.0s onward it is continuous live UI with a travelling pointer and no further dissolves. Teal ellipses drawn over the recording annotate the file-upload target at ~30s, the Optional block at 45s and the sub-nav tabs at 78-81s.
source_value.interruption_or_reversal: The Filter panel opened over the To pay list at ~83.0s is dismissed at ~85.5s without applying a filter: the list is identical before and after (same two rows, "To pay 267.02") and the blue "Pay all · 267.02" button becomes visible again (media/motion.mp4 83.0-85.5s).
source_value.feedback: Each committed action redraws numbers in the same frame: submitting the expense claim puts 243.92 under "Submitted" by 54s, adding the 33 mi mileage claim raises "To be paid" from 0.00 to 23.10 by 66s, and choosing "Approve" from the row overflow menu between 73.0s and 75.0s flips "Submitted" 243.92 to 0.00 and "To be paid" 23.10 to 267.02 by 75.5s while the sub-nav counts settle at "To review 0 / To pay 2".
